name: Ghillie Mantle
description: Camouflage mantle that makes you harder for monsters to detect.
effect: Conceals the wearer from monsters. Monsters will not target you unless you attack or get too close. Movement speed slightly reduced.
acquisition: HR 4 — Complete 4 deliveries for the Research Base (Botanical Research). Talk to the Botanist after completing "The Food Chain" (HR 8 optional) or complete 1★ Delivery "A Living Fossil" chain. Obtained from Armory → Specialized Tools.
upgrade_quest: Iceborne MR 4 — Optional 5★ "We Know Where You Live" (MR). Hunt a Yian Garuga in the Guiding Lands forest area.
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→180s, Cooldown 300→210s, adds 1× Lv2 decoration slot.

name: Temporal Mantle
description: Automatically evades powerful attacks for a short time.
effect: Automatically dodges high-damage roars, wind pressure and most physical attacks. Breaks after evading a set number of strong attacks (5). Does not block continuous or multi-hit damage perfectly.
acquisition: HR 16 — After clearing story (Xeno'jiiva) and reaching HR 16, complete Special Assignment 9★ "No Remorse, No Surrender" (Teostra + Lunastra in Wildspire Waste). Talk to the Armory after.
upgrade_quest: MR 6 — Optional 6★ "Ticked, Tacked & Toed" (Tempered Zinogre + Tempered Lunastra in Guiding Lands).
upgrade_effect: Cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv3 slots, evasion charges 5→6.

name: Health Booster
description: Placed booster that continuously restores HP to nearby hunters.
effect: Place a Health Booster that creates a healing field (radius ~6m). Restores ~10 HP per tick for 60s. Allies affected.
acquisition: Story Quest "One for the History Books" — awarded after your first encounter with Zorah Magdaros (Low Rank). Talk to the Armory in Astera.
upgrade_quest: MR2 "Fiesty Girl Talk" (Hunt Rathian + Pink Rathian in Wildspire Waste) — requires reaching Master Rank and encountering a Master Rank Pink Rathian. Prerequisite chain: MR2 "Fool's Mate" (MR4), MR2 "A Queen at Heart" (MR6), MR2 "Pink Power Grab" (MR6) before Fiesty Girl Talk unlocks. Also counts as Health Booster+.
upgrade_effect: Healing tick faster and slightly larger field. Adds 1x Lv1 decoration slot when upgraded.

name: Rocksteady Mantle
description: Negates damage reactions and earplugs, wind and tremor effects.
effect: Negates knockback, flinch, tremor, wind pressure and roar stun. Damage still taken (no damage reduction in base).
acquisition: HR 14 — Complete 8★ Optional "A Wound and a Reminder" (HR 14, hunt Tempered Kirin + Tempered Teostra + Tempered Kushala). Unlocks after story Teostra/Kushala quests.
upgrade_quest: MR 6 — Optional 6★ "A Shocking Climax" (Tempered Zinogre).
upgrade_effect: Duration 90→120s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv2 slots. Iceborne nerf: still reduces damage taken by 30% is removed (World nerf), but + gives extra slots.

name: Challenger Mantle
description: Taunts monsters and boosts attack when targeted.
effect: Taunts all nearby large monsters to attack you. While active, Affinity +10% and Attack +15 if a monster is targeting you.
acquisition: HR 12 — Complete 7★ Optional "New World Sky, New World Flower" (Hunt Tempered Rathalos + Rathian in Arena).
upgrade_quest: MR 3 — Optional 4★ "Sterling Pride" (Silver Rathalos observation).
upgrade_effect: Duration 180→210s, cooldown 300→210s, adds 1× Lv3 slot, affinity bonus 10→20% when enraged.

name: Vitality Mantle
description: Absorbs a fixed amount of damage before expiring.
effect: Adds a shield that absorbs ~80 HP of damage. Effect ends early if shield breaks. Does not negate statuses.
acquisition: HR 11 — Complete 6★ Optional "A Summons from Below" (Hunt Odogaron + Vaal Hazak track collection).
upgrade_quest: MR 4 — Optional 5★ "Unbridled Mayhem" (Savage Deviljho).
upgrade_effect: Absorption 80→100 HP, cooldown 360→300s, adds 1× Lv2 slot.

name: Glider Mantle
description: Allows gliding and easier mounting while negating wind pressure.
effect: Extend jumps into glides, negates minor wind pressure, enables aerial mounting attacks. Can use with ledges and wedges.
acquisition: HR 11 — Complete 6★ Optional "The Leap of Faith" (hunt Legiana + Paolumu) and talk to the Third Fleet Master.
upgrade_quest: MR 2 — Optional 3★ "Flourishing Frost" (Legiana variant chain in Hoarfrost).
upgrade_effect: Duration 180→210s, cooldown 210→180s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Evasion Mantle
description: Boosts evasion and attack when evading perfectly.
effect: Extends invulnerability window of dodges. After a perfect evade, Attack +30 for 30s and Affinity +15%. Stacks with evade skills.
acquisition: HR 10 — Complete 6★ Optional "Like a Moth to the Flame" (hunt Rathalos + Bazelgeuse) and deliver Research materials.
upgrade_quest: MR 5 — Optional 5★ "Come Out and Play" (Nargacuga + Tigrex).
upgrade_effect: Cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv2 slots, perfect evade window +2 frames.

name: Impact Mantle
description: Adds stun effect to most attacks.
effect: All attacks gain Stun value (KO). Effective with fast-hitting weapons. Adds 10% blunt-like stun per hit.
acquisition: HR 13 — Complete 7★ Optional "Specter from the Shadow" (Hunt tempered Nergigante follow-up).
upgrade_quest: MR 4 — Optional 5★ "The Storm Brings the Unexpected" (Namielle).
upgrade_effect: Stun value +20%, cooldown 360→300s, adds 1× Lv3 slot.

name: Apothecary Mantle
description: Enhances status application for your weapon.
effect: Boosts status buildup (paralysis, sleep, poison, blast) by ~30% while sliding/wallrun? Actually passively boosts status on all attacks while worn.
acquisition: HR 9 — Complete 6★ Optional "A Wound and a Thirst" (hunt Rathian + Pink Rathian).
upgrade_quest: MR 5 — Optional 5★ "The Heralds of Destruction Cry" (Brachydios + Glavenus).
upgrade_effect: Status buildup 30→40%, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv2 slots.

name: Bandit Mantle
description: Makes monsters drop rare trade-in items when attacked.
effect: Hits generate extra shiny drops (trade-in items: Bandit Shards, golden scales). More drops on weak points.
acquisition: HR 8 — Complete 5★ Optional "Redefining the Power Couple" (Hunt Rathian + Rathalos in Arena).
upgrade_quest: MR 3 — Optional 4★ "We Run This Town" (Gold Rathian).
upgrade_effect: Drop rate +30%, duration 180→210s, cooldown 300→210s, adds 1× Lv2 slot.

name: Fireproof Mantle
description: Negates fire damage, fireblight and blastblight damage.
effect: Negates fire elemental damage, fireblight, and blastblight. Gives Fire Res +30. Nullifies lava floor damage.
acquisition: HR 8 — Hunt Teostra (6★ "Teostra the Infernal") and deliver Teostra materials to Armory.
upgrade_quest: MR 5 — Optional 5★ "Burned to a Cinder" (Tempered Teostra in Guiding Lands).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Waterproof Mantle
description: Negates water damage and waterblight.
effect: Negates water elemental damage and waterblight (stamina recovery halved). Gives Water Res +30.
acquisition: HR 8 — Hunt Jyuratodus + Beotodus? Actually delivered by Coral Highlands Troupers quest chain (reach Lv6 with them) or HR 10 Optional "A Rush of Blood".
upgrade_quest: MR 3 — Optional 4★ "Torrential Downpour" (Tempered Coral Pukei).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Iceproof Mantle
description: Negates ice damage and iceblight.
effect: Negates ice elemental damage and iceblight (stamina consumption up). Gives Ice Res +30.
acquisition: HR 8 — Hunt Legiana (6★ "Legiana: Embodiment of Elegance") and deliver Legiana materials.
upgrade_quest: MR 4 — Optional 5★ "Absolute Whiteout" (Tempered Velkhana).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Thunderproof Mantle
description: Negates thunder damage and thunderblight.
effect: Negates thunder elemental damage and thunderblight (stun). Gives Thunder Res +30. Protects from Kirin thunder.
acquisition: HR 9 — Hunt Kirin (6★ "Kirin the Myth") after gathering Elder Tracks.
upgrade_quest: MR 5 — Optional 6★ "Thunderous Rumble Yet Again" (Tempered Kirin + Zinogre).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Dragonproof Mantle
description: Negates dragon damage and dragonblight.
effect: Negates dragon elemental damage and dragonblight (element/status disabled). Gives Dragon Res +30.
acquisition: HR 13 — Hunt Nergigante / Xeno'jiiva materials post-story (deliver Nergigante Talons).
upgrade_quest: MR 6 — Optional 6★ "The Darkest Night" (Safi'jiiva recon + Stygian Zinogre).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 2× Lv1 slots.

name: Immunity Mantle
description: Negates all status ailments and abnormal statuses.
effect: Prevents poison, paralysis, sleep, blastblight, stun, effluvia, and grants wind/odor negation.
acquisition: HR 10 — Complete 7★ Optional "Scattering Sapphire Stars" (?) Actually HR 10 "A Sore Site" chain and deliver Vaal Hazak materials (effluvia).
upgrade_quest: MR 5 — Optional 5★ "Eternal Vengeance" (Tempered Vaal Hazak + Blackveil).
upgrade_effect: Duration 120→150s, cooldown 360→300s, adds 1× Lv3 + 1× Lv1 slots.

name: Assassin's Hood
description: Increases movement speed, hide speed and damage from the shadows.
effect: Movement speed +30%, hide faster, next attack from stealth deals +30% damage. Monsters take longer to detect you. Assassin's Creed collaboration, but also in base via delivery.
acquisition: 8★ Event Quest "SDF: Silent, Deadly and Fierce" (Odogaron + Deviljho + Lunastra in Special Arena) — collect Senu's Feather. Exchange 2x Senu's Feather + 5000 Research Points at the Armory. NOTE: Quest removed in 2021 due to licensing expiry — no longer obtainable if not already owned.
upgrade_quest: MR3 Event Quest "The Assassin" (Hunt Tempered Nargacuga in Ancient Forest) — unlocks Assassin's Hood + with 2x Lv2 decoration slots.
upgrade_effect: Duration 180→210s, cooldown 300→210s, adds 2x Lv2 decoration slots, stealth damage +30→40%.

name: Affinity Booster
description: Placed booster that raises affinity of nearby hunters.
effect: Place an Affinity Booster that grants Affinity +50% (critical chance) to all hunters in radius for 60s.
acquisition: Third Fleet Master chain (Research Base): 6★ A Tingling Taste (Hunt Great Girros) → Delivery A Master's Toast → 6★ Stuck in Their Ways (Capture Tobi-Kadachi) → Delivery A Fire-Spewing Brew → 7★ A Sore Site (Hunt Odogaron) → 7★ RRRRRumble in the Waste! (Hunt Diablos + Black Diablos) → return to Third Fleet Master in Research Base.
upgrade_quest: MR6 "The Storm Brings the Unexpected" (Hunt tempered Kushala Daora + tempered Blackveil Vaal Hazak in Ancient Forest) — unlocks at MR175, post-story only.
upgrade_effect: Affinity 50→60%, cooldown 180→150s. Adds 1x Lv1 decoration slot.

name: Cleanser Booster
description: Placed booster that cures ailments and blights.
effect: Cures poison, paralysis, sleep, stun, blights and effluvia every few seconds for hunters inside the field. Also removes Defense Down.
acquisition: 4★ Optional Quest "On Nightmare's Wings" — slay Raphinos in Rotten Vale, then speak to the Armory lady in Astera.
upgrade_quest: MR2 "Poison and Paralysis Pinch" (Capture Viper Tobi-Kadachi in Hoarfrost Reach).
upgrade_effect: Tick rate faster (3→2s), cures additional blights. Adds 1x Lv1 decoration slot.
